prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, choose_path new_flow, finish new_screen, finish redesign, home new_flow, home notification, and sign_in hint, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 3 tests, home wait_info across 2 tests, or sign_in reorder across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear positive effect, with one test showing no clear effect and another causing a severe drop that required an early stop.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for minor tweaks while severely underestimating major positive wins like the adoption redesign.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +1.8% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: -1.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -6.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -3.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -1.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Onboarding Goal Selector Flow: Introduce an intent goal selection screen prior to path selection, letting users define whether their pet is for productivity, entertainment, or focus. (why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate with high mean duration (514s). Defining the companion's primary role upfront aligns user expectations early.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction Sandbox Screen: Add a hands-on sandbox screen at the finish step where users practice dragging, toggling visibility, and interacting with their pet before desktop deployment. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding, while finish conversion sits at only 64.8%.)
2: [home, new_flow] Async Generation Mini Game Flow: Add an interactive waiting room mini-game sub-screen during pet rendering so users remain active while waiting for desktop setup. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s. Active engagement prevents drop-off and frustration during long background tasks.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Readiness Hub Redesign: Redesign home intro into a two-column readiness hub showing shortcuts, system tray locations, and quick toggle keys. (why: Support receives multiple post-onboarding queries regarding pet controls and system tray location, and finish step conversion is lowest at 64.8%.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Protection Hint: Display a prominent hint explaining that signing in safeguards companion data from being lost upon app updates or reboots. (why: 8 support tickets (the largest single category) reported pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Verification Screen: Insert a photo quality check screen that validates lighting and crop before custom pet creation starts. (why: Support received emails regarding custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results during adoption.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Audio Readiness Cue: Enable system alerts and an audio notification chime when background pet rendering finishes. (why: Support reported issues with pets not displaying or users missing when background processing finishes after long delays.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Path Selection Layout: Switch the choose_path screen layout to spotlight mode, displaying path benefits one featured card at a time. (why: 23.8% drop off at choose_path with a 514s mean time, showing decision fatigue across available options.)
